 NFC Notes: Romello Height, Sean McVay, Brandon McManus, 49ers, Rams
 By Tony Camino - October 23, 2026 
 49ers 
 49ers DE Romello Height had three tackles, a half-sack, and a season-high of five quarterback pressures in Monday Night’s win over the Commanders. Height credits his performance to wearing new cleats in Week 6. 
 “I just felt like I was slipping a lot with the old (cleats),” Height said, via Matt Barrows of The Athletic. “I grabbed some new ones, and I was ready to roll.” 
 Height has been playing with a club on his right hand since Week 3. The defensive end said he’s been studying former linebackers like Patrick Willis and Takeo Spikes , who played well wearing a club. 
 “Those guys actually had success wearing the club,” Height said. “They had a continuous motor, a real determination, a real passion for the game — not wanting to be away from the game. So when (doctors) told me I could play with the club, I was like, ‘I can’t wait. Let’s go.’” 
 As for WR Mike Evans (Achilles), HC Kyle Shanahan said his injury will be something they have to manage going forward. 
 “We had to manage it last week, and we’re managing it this week,” Shanahan said. “So we’ll see how the rest of the year goes.” 
 Rams 
 With WR Davante Adams and TE Terrance Ferguson on injured reserve, some have wondered if the Rams will look into an external addition to bolster their pass-catching group. Rams HC Sean McVay said they haven’t looked into anything like that yet because of their belief in the depth.
 “That’s not something that we’ve talked about right now,” McVay said, via the team’s website . “We’ve got some depth on our roster. Maybe we talked about the practice squad, but not anything external.” 
 Rams QB Matthew Stafford talked specifically about his faith in WR Konata Mumpfield because of his attitude and energy.
 “Obviously with Tae going down, everybody’s going to get more opportunities,” Stafford said. “He’s (Mumpfield) a guy that has had some and done a nice job with them. He’s going to continue to grow. He’s, again, young in his journey as a player in the NFL. He’s a really talented kid. He soaks it all up, wants to be good. We’re looking for just his best like everybody else. Just bring us your best, bring us that attitude, that want to, and that energy. As long as he does that, he’ll be fine.” 
 Rams 
 Rams K Brandon McManus said he’s excited for the opportunity to kick for the team but added his sympathy for K Blake Grupe , who suffered a torn ACL.
 “ It’s exciting, ” McManus said, via the team’s website . “ Any chance you get to play this game that I love and have had the chance to play for a long time. I was excited to get the call to come out to do the workout yesterday, and I feel bad for Blake, obviously. He had the opportunity to come in and make a kick for the Rams and then he got hurt, so I wish him the best in his recovery. But it was exciting to get the call to come work out for this great organization .”
 McManus added that he’s no stranger to being called into action mid season and knows that he can make it work.
 “ I went in the Green Bay in the middle of the season a couple years ago with a new snapper and new holder,” McManus said. “ And when I was in Denver, I was just telling it to (Rams punter Ethan (Evans), I might have had eight or nine punters in my nine years there. So I’m used to seeing new things. ”
